links.label: Founded 1998. Retains 12% equity and a board seat.
Acquired 64% controlling stake 2010. SEC filing: APX-2010-13D.
$12M endowment commitment 2019. Apex managing partner sits on NPI board.

apex_holdings::policy_institute.what: Apex Holdings committed $12 million to the National Policy Institute endowment in 2019, making it the largest single donor. An Apex managing partner simultaneously holds a seat on the NPI board of trustees.
apex_holdings::policy_institute.how: Documented in NPI Form 990 filings 2019–2022 (Schedule B, Donor #1). Board interlocking confirmed in NPI Annual Report 2020 biography section.
apex_holdings::policy_institute.impact: NPI's published research on financial deregulation aligns with Apex portfolio interests. Two NPI white papers were cited in Senate hearings on regulations directly affecting Apex portfolio companies in 2021 and 2023.
